body: 上传手绘草图是唯一建筑设计来源。将它转换成写实建筑摄影，严格保持坡屋顶、门、三扇窗、三级台阶、空间比例、视角和构图。竖向浅雪松木墙板、深灰金属屋顶、黑色细窗框、混凝土台阶，柔和日光，真实材质纹理，空旷灰色地面。不要增删门窗或装饰，4:3。

instructions.en: Upload the reference images in the listed order. The example uses synthetic input images.
instructions.zh-Hans: 按列出的顺序上传参考图。本例使用合成输入素材。

en.title: Cabin sketch to realistic rendering
en.description: The gable, front door, three windows and three steps preserve the sketch arrangement and perspective, with wood, metal and concrete materials added.
en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

The gable, front door, three windows and three steps preserve the sketch arrangement and perspective, with wood, metal and concrete materials added.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 41. [Source](https://github.com/qzh3722/awesome-nano-banana-spatial-design/blob/main/README.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.

## 使用方法

复制本图实际使用的完整提示词。修改主体后属于尚未验证的新变体。生成前，按顺序上传运行记录中展示的合成参考图。

## 观察结果

坡屋顶、前门、三窗与三级台阶保留草图布局及透视，补充木材、金属与混凝土材质。
